chapterTag.category: AP Calc AB Unit 1 — Limits & Continuity

body.en: Unit 1 · Limits & Continuity covers essential College Board AP Calculus AB competencies across foundational mechanics, intermediate analysis, and advanced FRQ problem solving.
body.ar: Unit 1 · النهايات & Continuity covers essential College Board AP التفاضل والتكامل AB competencies across foundational mechanics, intermediate analysis, and advanced FRQ problem solving.

blocks.heading: Level 1 · Foundations — Limit Evaluation & Indeterminate Forms

body.en: Evaluate one-sided and two-sided limits analytically using direct substitution, factoring, rationalizing, and the squeeze theorem.
body.ar: احسب قيمة one-sided and two-sided النهايات analytically using direct substitution, factoring, rationalizing, and the squeeze المبرهنة.

body.en:
A function \( f \) is continuous at a point \( x = c \) if and only if all three conditions are satisfied:

  1. \( f(c) \) is defined: \( c \) is in the domain of \( f \).
  2. \( \displaystyle \lim_{x \to c} f(x) \) exists: \( \displaystyle \lim_{x \to c^-} f(x) = \lim_{x \to c^+} f(x) = L \), where \( L \) is finite.
  3. \( \displaystyle \lim_{x \to c} f(x) = f(c) \): The limit value equals the function output.
body.ar:
A الدالة \( f \) is continuous at a point \( x = c \) if and only if all three conditions are satisfied:

  1. \( f(c) \) is defined: \( c \) is in the المجال of \( f \).
  2. \( \displaystyle \lim_{x \to c} f(x) \) exists: \( \displaystyle \lim_{x \to c^-} f(x) = \lim_{x \to c^+} f(x) = L \), حيث \( L \) is finite.
  3. \( \displaystyle \lim_{x \to c} f(x) = f(c) \): The النهاية value equals the الدالة output.

label.en: ● Complete Taxonomy of Continuity & Discontinuity Graphs
label.ar: ● Complete Taxonomy of Continuity & Discontinuity Graphs (الوحدة ١ · النهايات والاتصال)

body.en:
Depending on which conditions of the continuity checklist fail, graphs display one of seven geometric cases:

  • Case 1 · Continuous everywhere at \(c\): All 3 conditions hold without interruption: \(f(c)\) is defined, \(\lim_{x\to c} f(x) = L\) exists, and \(\lim_{x\to c} f(x) = f(c)\).
  • Case 2 · Removable Discontinuity (Hole): Condition 1 fails (\(f(c)\) undefined), while Condition 2 passes (\(\lim_{x\to c} f(x)\) exists).
  • Case 3 · Removable Discontinuity (Displaced Point): Conditions 1 & 2 pass, but Condition 3 fails (\(\lim_{x\to c} f(x) \neq f(c)\)).
  • Case 4 · Jump Discontinuity: Condition 2 fails because one-sided limits are finite but unequal: \(\lim_{x\to c^-} f(x) \neq \lim_{x\to c^+} f(x)\).
  • Case 5 · Infinite Discontinuity (Vertical Asymptote): Condition 2 fails because one or both one-sided limits grow without bound (\(\pm\infty\)).
  • Case 6 · Oscillating Discontinuity: Condition 2 fails because outputs oscillate infinitely many times between bounds (e.g., \(\sin(2/(x-c))\)).
  • Case 7 · One-Sided / Endpoint Continuity: The function is defined on a closed or half-closed interval such as \([a, b]\); the two-sided limit does not exist at boundary point \(c = a\) because values outside \([a, b]\) are undefined, but the one-sided limit matches the endpoint value: \(\lim_{x\to a^+} f(x) = f(a)\).

title.en: Case 1 · Continuous at an Interior Point \((c = 1)\)
title.ar: Case 1 · Continuous at an Interior Point \((c = 1)\) (الوحدة ١ · النهايات والاتصال)

caption.en: All three conditions hold: (1) \(f(1) = 1.5\) is defined; (2) \(\lim_{x\to 1} f(x) = 1.5\) exists; (3) \(\lim_{x\to 1} f(x) = f(1)\). The parabola \(f(x) = 0.5(x-1)^2 + 1.5\) passes through \((1, 1.5)\) unbroken.
caption.ar: All three conditions hold: (1) \(f(1) = 1.5\) is defined; (2) \(\lim_{x\to 1} f(x) = 1.5\) exists; (3) \(\lim_{x\to 1} f(x) = f(1)\). The القطع المكافئ \(f(x) = 0.5(x-1)^2 + 1.5\) passes through \((1, 1.5)\) unbroken.

title.ar: Case 2 · Removable Discontinuity — Missing Point (Hole) (الوحدة ١ · النهايات والاتصال)

caption.en: Condition 1 fails because \(f(1)\) is undefined (a hole at \((1, 2)\)). However, Condition 2 passes because \(\lim_{x\to 1^-} f(x) = \lim_{x\to 1^+} f(x) = 2.0\). The discontinuity is 'removable' by defining \(f(1) = 2\).
caption.ar: توضيح رياضي: Condition 1 fails because \(f(1)\) is undefined (a hole at \((1, 2)\)). However, Condition 2 passes because \(\lim_{x\to 1^-} f(x) = \lim_{x\to 1^+} f(x) = 2.0\). The discontinuity is 'removable' by defining \(f(1) = 2\).

title.ar: Case 3 · Removable Discontinuity — Displaced Point (الوحدة ١ · النهايات والاتصال)

caption.en: Conditions 1 & 2 pass (\(f(1) = 3.5\) is defined and \(\lim_{x\to 1} f(x) = 2.0\) exists), but Condition 3 fails because \(\lim_{x\to 1} f(x) \neq f(1)\). The isolated point at \((1, 3.5)\) is detached from the continuous line.
caption.ar: توضيح رياضي: Conditions 1 & 2 pass (\(f(1) = 3.5\) is defined and \(\lim_{x\to 1} f(x) = 2.0\) exists), but Condition 3 fails because \(\lim_{x\to 1} f(x) \neq f(1)\). The isolated point at \((1, 3.5)\) is detached from the continuous line.

title.ar: Case 4 · Jump Discontinuity (Finite Jump) (الوحدة ١ · النهايات والاتصال)

caption.en: Condition 2 fails because the one-sided limits are finite but unequal: \(\lim_{x\to 1^-} f(x) = 1.5\) while \(\lim_{x\to 1^+} f(x) = 3.0\). The branches fail to meet, leaving an unavoidable jump gap of \(|3.0 - 1.5| = 1.5\).
caption.ar: Condition 2 fails because the one-sided النهايات are finite but unequal: \(\lim_{x\to 1^-} f(x) = 1.5\) while \(\lim_{x\to 1^+} f(x) = 3.0\). The branches fail to meet, leaving an unavoidable jump gap of \(|3.0 - 1.5| = 1.5\).

caption.en: Condition 2 fails because outputs grow without bound: \(\lim_{x\to 1^-} f(x) = -\infty\) and \(\lim_{x\to 1^+} f(x) = +\infty\). The line \(x = 1\) is a vertical asymptote that the curve approaches indefinitely without ever crossing.
caption.ar: Condition 2 fails because outputs grow without bound: \(\lim_{x\to 1^-} f(x) = -\infty\) and \(\lim_{x\to 1^+} f(x) = +\infty\). The line \(x = 1\) is a vertical خط التقارب that the curve approaches indefinitely without ever crossing.

title.ar: Case 6 · Essential / Oscillating Discontinuity (الوحدة ١ · النهايات والاتصال)

caption.en: Condition 2 fails because \(f(x) = \sin(2/(x-1))\) oscillates infinitely many times between \(-1\) and \(+1\) as \(x \to 1\). Because the function values never settle upon any single finite value, no two-sided limit exists.
caption.ar: Condition 2 fails because \(f(x) = \sin(2/(x-1))\) oscillates infinitely many times between \(-1\) and \(+1\) as \(x \to 1\). Because the الدالة values never settle upon any single finite value, no two-sided النهاية exists.

caption.en: For \(f(x) = \sqrt{x - 1} + 1.5\) on domain \([1, \infty)\), the two-sided limit at \(x = 1\) does not exist because \(x < 1\) is outside the domain. However, \(f\) is continuous from the right because \(\lim_{x\to 1^+} f(x) = f(1) = 1.5\). By standard mathematical definition, \(f\) is continuous on \([1, \infty)\).
caption.ar: For \(f(x) = \sqrt{x - 1} + 1.5\) on المجال \([1, \infty)\), the two-sided النهاية at \(x = 1\) does not exist because \(x < 1\) is outside the المجال. However, \(f\) is continuous from the right because \(\lim_{x\to 1^+} f(x) = f(1) = 1.5\). By standard mathematical definition, \(f\) is continuous on \([1, \infty)\).

label.en: ● Precise \((\varepsilon, \delta)\) Definition of Limit & Rigorous Proofs
label.ar: ● Precise \((\varepsilon, \delta)\) تعريف of النهاية & Rigorous Proofs

body.en:
Definition: \(\displaystyle\lim_{x \to c} f(x) = L\) means: for every \(\varepsilon > 0\), there exists \(\delta > 0\) such that \(0 < |x - c| < \delta \implies |f(x) - L| < \varepsilon\).

Rigorous Proof (Linear): Prove that \(\lim_{x\to 3} (4x - 5) = 7\).
Scratchwork: \(|(4x - 5) - 7| = 4|x - 3| < \varepsilon \iff |x - 3| < \frac{\varepsilon}{4}\).
Proof: Let \(\varepsilon > 0\). Choose \(\delta = \frac{\varepsilon}{4}\). If \(0 < |x - 3| < \delta\), then \(|(4x - 5) - 7| = 4|x - 3| < 4\left(\frac{\varepsilon}{4}\right) = \varepsilon\). Thus \(\lim_{x\to 3}(4x - 5) = 7\). \(\blacksquare\)

Rigorous Proof (Quadratic with Bounding): Prove that \(\lim_{x\to 2} x^2 = 4\).
Scratchwork: \(|x^2 - 4| = |x - 2||x + 2|\). Restrict \(\delta \le 1 \implies 1 < x < 3 \implies |x + 2| < 5\). Then \(|x^2 - 4| < 5|x - 2|\). Set \(5|x - 2| < \varepsilon \iff |x - 2| < \frac{\varepsilon}{5}\). Choose \(\delta = \min\left(1, \frac{\varepsilon}{5}\right)\).
Proof: Let \(\varepsilon > 0\). Set \(\delta = \min\left(1, \frac{\varepsilon}{5}\right)\). If \(0 < |x - 2| < \delta\), then \(|x + 2| < 5\) and \(|x - 2| < \frac{\varepsilon}{5}\). Thus \(|x^2 - 4| = |x - 2||x + 2| < \left(\frac{\varepsilon}{5}\right)(5) = \varepsilon\). Hence \(\lim_{x\to 2} x^2 = 4\). \(\blacksquare\)

label.en: ● Precise Definitions of Limits at Infinity & Infinite Limits (with Proofs)
label.ar: ● Precise Definitions of النهايات at Infinity & Infinite النهايات (with Proofs)

body.en:
1. Limit at Infinity: \(\displaystyle\lim_{x\to \infty} f(x) = L\) means \(\forall \varepsilon > 0, \exists M > 0\) such that \(x > M \implies |f(x) - L| < \varepsilon\).

Proof for \(\lim_{x\to\infty} \frac{2x+1}{x+3} = 2\): For \(x > 0\), \(\left|\frac{2x+1}{x+3} - 2\right| = \frac{5}{x+3} < \varepsilon \iff x > \frac{5}{\varepsilon} - 3\). Choose \(M = \max\left(1, \frac{5}{\varepsilon} - 3\right)\). For all \(x > M\): \(\left|\frac{2x+1}{x+3} - 2\right| < \frac{5}{M+3} \le \varepsilon\). \(\blacksquare\)

2. Infinite Limits at a Point: \(\displaystyle\lim_{x\to c} f(x) = \infty\) means \(\forall M > 0, \exists \delta > 0\) such that \(0 < |x - c| < \delta \implies f(x) > M\).

Proof for \(\lim_{x\to 0} \frac{1}{x^2} = \infty\): Let \(M > 0\). Choose \(\delta = \frac{1}{\sqrt{M}}\). If \(0 < |x| < \delta\), then \(x^2 < \frac{1}{M} \implies \frac{1}{x^2} > M\). \(\blacksquare\)
body.ar:
1. النهاية at Infinity: \(\displaystyle\lim_{x\to \infty} f(x) = L\) means \(\forall \varepsilon > 0, \exists M > 0\) such that \(x > M \implies |f(x) - L| < \varepsilon\).

Proof for \(\lim_{x\to\infty} \frac{2x+1}{x+3} = 2\): For \(x > 0\), \(\left|\frac{2x+1}{x+3} - 2\right| = \frac{5}{x+3} < \varepsilon \iff x > \frac{5}{\varepsilon} - 3\). Choose \(M = \max\left(1, \frac{5}{\varepsilon} - 3\right)\). For all \(x > M\): \(\left|\frac{2x+1}{x+3} - 2\right| < \frac{5}{M+3} \le \varepsilon\). \(\blacksquare\)

2. Infinite النهايات at a Point: \(\displaystyle\lim_{x\to c} f(x) = \infty\) means \(\forall M > 0, \exists \delta > 0\) such that \(0 < |x - c| < \delta \implies f(x) > M\).

Proof for \(\lim_{x\to 0} \frac{1}{x^2} = \infty\): Let \(M > 0\). Choose \(\delta = \frac{1}{\sqrt{M}}\). If \(0 < |x| < \delta\), then \(x^2 < \frac{1}{M} \implies \frac{1}{x^2} > M\). \(\blacksquare\)

label.en: ◆ Why It Works — First-Principles Derivation (Unit 1 · Limits & Continuity)
label.ar: ◆ لماذا تعمل هذه الطريقة رياضياً — First-Principles اشتقاق (Unit 1 · النهايات & Continuity)

body.en:
Why Differentiability Implies Continuity & How Implicit Differentiation Works: Notice that for \(x \ne a\), we can write \(f(x) - f(a) = \dfrac{f(x) - f(a)}{x - a}\cdot (x - a)\). Taking the limit as \(x \to a\) by the Product Law gives:

\[ \lim_{x \to a} \bigl(f(x) - f(a)\bigr) = f'(a)\cdot 0 = 0 \implies \lim_{x \to a} f(x) = f(a) \]

Similarly, when differentiating an implicit relation \(F(x, y) = c\) with respect to \(x\), \(y = y(x)\) is an inner function of \(x\). By the Chain Rule, \(\dfrac{d}{dx}\bigl[y^n\bigr] = ny^{n-1}\dfrac{dy}{dx}\), and for product terms \(\dfrac{d}{dx}[xy] = y + x\dfrac{dy}{dx}\).
body.ar:
Why Differentiability Implies Continuity & How Implicit Differentiation Works: Notice that for \(x \ne a\), we can write \(f(x) - f(a) = \dfrac{f(x) - f(a)}{x - a}\cdot (x - a)\). Taking the النهاية as \(x \to a\) by the Product Law gives:

\[ \lim_{x \to a} \bigl(f(x) - f(a)\bigr) = f'(a)\cdot 0 = 0 \implies \lim_{x \to a} f(x) = f(a) \]

Similarly, عندما differentiating an implicit relation \(F(x, y) = c\) بالنسبة إلى \(x\), \(y = y(x)\) is an inner الدالة of \(x\). By the Chain Rule, \(\dfrac{d}{dx}\bigl[y^n\bigr] = ny^{n-1}\dfrac{dy}{dx}\), and for product terms \(\dfrac{d}{dx}[xy] = y + x\dfrac{dy}{dx}\).

label.en: Worked Example A — Unit 1 · Limits & Continuity (Easy Application)
label.ar: مثال محلول A — Unit 1 · النهايات & Continuity (Easy Application)

body.en:
Problem (Easy): Consider the function \( f(x) = x^2 - 5x + 6 \). What is the value of \( \lim_{x \to 3} f(x) \)?

Step-by-Step Solution: To find the limit of the function \( f(x) = x^2 - 5x + 6 \) as \( x \) approaches 3, we can directly substitute \( x = 3 \) into the function because it is a polynomial and therefore continuous everywhere. \( \lim_{x \to 3} (x^2 - 5x + 6) \) Substitute \( x = 3 \): \( (3)^2 - 5(3) + 6 \) \( 9 - 15 + 6 \) \( -6 + 6 \) \( 0 \) Therefore, the limit of the function as \( x \) approaches 3 is 0.
body.ar:
Problem (Easy): Consider the الدالة \( f(x) = x^2 - 5x + 6 \). What is the value of \( \lim_{x \to 3} f(x) \)?

Step-by-Step الحل: To أوجد النهاية of the الدالة \( f(x) = x^2 - 5x + 6 \) as \( x \) approaches 3, we can directly عوّض \( x = 3 \) into the الدالة because it is a كثيرة الحدود and وبالتالي continuous everywhere. \( \lim_{x \to 3} (x^2 - 5x + 6) \) عوّض \( x = 3 \): \( (3)^2 - 5(3) + 6 \) \( 9 - 15 + 6 \) \( -6 + 6 \) \( 0 \) وبالتالي, the النهاية of the الدالة as \( x \) approaches 3 is 0.

label.en: Worked Example \(B\) — Unit 1 · Limits & Continuity (Medium Application)
label.ar: مثال محلول \(B\) — Unit 1 · النهايات & Continuity (Medium Application)

body.en:
Problem (Medium): Consider the function \( f(x) \) defined piecewise as: \[ f(x) = \begin{cases} \frac{x^2 - 9}{x - 3} & \text{if } x \neq 3 \\ k & \text{if } x = 3 \end{cases} \] For the function \( f(x) \) to be continuous at \( x = 3 \), the value of \( k \) must be such that the limit of \( f(x) \) as \( x \) approaches 3 exists and is equal to \( f(3) \). Which of the following statements is true regarding the continuity of \( f(x) \) at \( x = 3 \) if \( k \) is set to satisfy this condition, and what is the value of that limit?

Step-by-Step Solution: For \( f(x) \) to be continuous at \( x = 3 \), the limit of \( f(x) \) as \( x \) approaches 3 must exist and be equal to \( f(3) \). First, we evaluate the limit of \( f(x) \) as \( x \to 3 \): \(\lim_{x \to 3} \frac{x^2 - 9}{x - 3}\). This is an indeterminate form \(\frac{0}{0}\), so we can factor the numerator: \(\lim_{x \to 3} \frac{(x - 3)(x + 3)}{x - 3}\). For \( x \neq 3 \), we can cancel the \( (x - 3) \) terms: \(\lim_{x \to 3} (x + 3)\). Substituting \( x = 3 \) into the simplified expression gives \( 3 + 3 = 6 \). For continuity, \( f(3) \) must equal this limit, so \( k \) must be 6. Thus, the function is continuous at \( x = 3 \) and the limit is 6.
body.ar:
Problem (Medium): Consider the الدالة \( f(x) \) defined piecewise as: \[ f(x) = \begin{cases} \frac{x^2 - 9}{x - 3} & \text{if } x \neq 3 \\ k & \text{if } x = 3 \end{cases} \] For the الدالة \( f(x) \) to be continuous at \( x = 3 \), the value of \( k \) must be such that the النهاية of \( f(x) \) as \( x \) approaches 3 exists and is equal to \( f(3) \). Which of the following statements is true regarding the continuity of \( f(x) \) at \( x = 3 \) if \( k \) is set to satisfy this condition, and what is the value of that النهاية?

Step-by-Step الحل: For \( f(x) \) to be continuous at \( x = 3 \), the النهاية of \( f(x) \) as \( x \) approaches 3 must exist and be equal to \( f(3) \). First, we احسب قيمة النهاية of \( f(x) \) as \( x \to 3 \): \(\lim_{x \to 3} \frac{x^2 - 9}{x - 3}\). This is an indeterminate form \(\frac{0}{0}\), so we can factor the numerator: \(\lim_{x \to 3} \frac{(x - 3)(x + 3)}{x - 3}\). For \( x \neq 3 \), we can cancel the \( (x - 3) \) terms: \(\lim_{x \to 3} (x + 3)\). Substituting \( x = 3 \) into the simplified العبارة الجبرية gives \( 3 + 3 = 6 \). For continuity, \( f(3) \) must equal this النهاية, so \( k \) must be 6. وعليه, the الدالة is continuous at \( x = 3 \) and the النهاية is 6.

label.en: Worked Example \(C\) — Unit 1 · Limits & Continuity (Hard Application)
label.ar: مثال محلول \(C\) — Unit 1 · النهايات & Continuity (Hard Application)

body.en:
Problem (Hard): Consider the function \( f(x) \) graphed below. What is the limit of \( f(x) \) as \( x \) approaches 1, i.e., \( \lim_{x \to 1} f(x) \)?

Step-by-Step Solution: The limit of a function as \( x \) approaches a certain value is the \( y \)-value that the function approaches from both the left and the right. Observing the graph, as \( x \) gets closer and closer to 1 from both sides, the \( y \)-value of the function approaches 0.
body.ar:
Problem (Hard): Consider the الدالة \( f(x) \) graphed below. What is the النهاية of \( f(x) \) as \( x \) approaches 1, i.e., \( \lim_{x \to 1} f(x) \)?

Step-by-Step الحل: The النهاية of a الدالة as \( x \) approaches a certain value is the \( y \)-value that the الدالة approaches from both the left and the right. Observing the التمثيل البياني, as \( x \) gets closer and closer to 1 from both sides, the \( y \)-value of the الدالة approaches 0.

label.en: Worked Example \(D\) — Unit 1 · Limits & Continuity (Easy Application)
label.ar: مثال محلول \(D\) — Unit 1 · النهايات & Continuity (Easy Application)

body.en:
Problem (Easy): Evaluate the definite integral of the constant function: \( \int_{38}^{41} 81 \, dx \).

Step-by-Step Solution: The antiderivative is \( 81x \). Evaluating from \( 38 \) to \( 41 \) gives \( 81(41 - 38) = 243 \).
body.ar:
Problem (Easy): احسب قيمة definite التكامل of the الثابت الدالة: \( \int_{38}^{41} 81 \, dx \).

Step-by-Step الحل: The antiderivative is \( 81x \). Evaluating from \( 38 \) to \( 41 \) gives \( 81(41 - 38) = 243 \).

label.en: ⚠️ Common Exam Traps — Unit 1 · Limits & Continuity
label.ar: ⚠️ أخطاء شائعة في الاختبار — Unit 1 · النهايات & Continuity

body.en:
1. Premature L'Hôpital's Rule Application: On College Board AP Calculus AB, applying L'Hôpital's Rule to \(\lim_{x \to 3} \dfrac{g(x)}{h(x)}\) when the fraction is not an indeterminate form \(0/0\) or \(\infty/\infty\) produces completely false limits. Always verify \(g(3) = 0\) and \(h(3) = 0\) explicitly first.

2. Parametric Second Derivative Trap: For parametric curves \((x(t), y(t))\), \(\dfrac{d^2y}{dx^2} = \dfrac{\frac{d}{dt}(dy/dx)}{dx/dt}\), never \(\dfrac{d^2y/dt^2}{d^2x/dt^2}\).
body.ar:

2. Parametric Second المشتقة Trap: For parametric curves \((x(t), y(t))\), \(\dfrac{d^2y}{dx^2} = \dfrac{\frac{d}{dt}(dy/dx)}{dx/dt}\), never \(\dfrac{d^2y/dt^2}{d^2x/dt^2}\).

question.en:
Level 2 · Medium

Find the value of constant \(k\) that makes \(f(x) = \begin{cases} kx^2 + 1 & x \le 2 \\ 3x - 5 & x > 2 \end{cases}\) continuous at \(x = 2\).
question.ar:
Level 2 · Medium

أوجد قيمة constant \(k\) that makes \(f(x) = \begin{cases} kx^2 + 1 & x \le 2 \\ 3x - 5 & x > 2 \end{cases}\) continuous at \(x = 2\).

solution.en: Require left and right limits to match: \[ \lim_{x\to 2^-} (kx^2 + 1) = 4k + 1, \quad \lim_{x\to 2^+} (3x - 5) = 6 - 5 = 1. \] Set equal: \[ 4k + 1 = 1 \implies 4k = 0 \implies \mathbf{k = 0}. \]
solution.ar:

question.en:
Level 3 · Advanced

Let \(f(x) = x^3 - 3x - 1\). Explain how the Intermediate Value Theorem guarantees a root in \([1, 2]\).
question.ar:
Level 3 · Advanced

ليكن \(f(x) = x^3 - 3x - 1\). Explain how the Intermediate Value Theorem guarantees a root in \([1, 2]\).

solution.en:
1. \(f(x)\) is a polynomial, so it is continuous on \([1, 2]\).
2. \(f(1) = 1 - 3 - 1 = -3 < 0\), and \(f(2) = 8 - 6 - 1 = 1 > 0\).
3. Since \(0\) lies strictly between \(f(1) = -3\) and \(f(2) = 1\), by the IVT there must exist at least one \(c \in (1, 2)\) such that \(f(c) = 0\).

question.en: Consider the function \( f(x) = x^2 - 5x + 6 \). What is the limit of \( f(x) \) as \( x \) approaches 2?
question.ar: حل المسألة التالية في (Unit 1 · Limits & Continuity): Consider the function \( f(x) = x^2 - 5x + 6 \). What is the limit of \( f(x) \) as \( x \) approaches 2?

hints.en: To find the limit of the polynomial function \( f(x) = x^2 - 5x + 6 \) as \( x \) approaches 2, we can directly substitute \( x = 2 \) into the function because polynomials are continuous everywhere.
hints.ar: To أوجد limit of the polynomial function \( f(x) = x^2 - 5x + 6 \) as \( x \) approaches 2, we can directly عوّض \( x = 2 \) into the function because polynomials are continuous everyحيث.
أعد كتابة العلاقة وبسّطها للحصول على: \( \lim_{x \to 2} (x^2 - 5x + 6) = (2)^2 - 5(2) + 6 \) \( = 4 - 10 + 6 \) \( = 0 \).

solution.en:
To find the limit of the polynomial function \( f(x) = x^2 - 5x + 6 \) as \( x \) approaches 2, we can directly substitute \( x = 2 \) into the function because polynomials are continuous everywhere.

\( \lim_{x \to 2} (x^2 - 5x + 6) = (2)^2 - 5(2) + 6 \)
\( = 4 - 10 + 6 \)
\( = 0 \)

Therefore, the limit is 0.
solution.ar:
To أوجد limit of the polynomial function \( f(x) = x^2 - 5x + 6 \) as \( x \) approaches 2, we can directly عوّض \( x = 2 \) into the function because polynomials are continuous everyحيث.

\( \lim_{x \to 2} (x^2 - 5x + 6) = (2)^2 - 5(2) + 6 \)
\( = 4 - 10 + 6 \)
\( = 0 \)

وبالتالي، the limit is 0.

label.en: ● Master Atlas of the 9 Main Parent Functions & Universal Transformation Law
label.ar: ● الأطلس الشامل للدوال الأم التسع وقانون التحويلات الهندسية العام

body.en:
Every algebraic and elementary transcendental model is built by transforming one of the nine core parent functions via \(g(x) = a\,f(x - h) + k\), where \(|a|\) scales vertically (reflecting across the \(x\)-axis if \(a < 0\)), \(h\) shifts horizontally, and \(k\) shifts vertically:

FamilyTransformed Form \(g(x)\)DomainRange (\(a > 0\))Key Geometric Feature
Constant\(f(x) = c\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\(\{c\}\)Horizontal line, slope \(0\)
Linear\(a(x - h) + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)Constant slope \(m = a\), pivot \((h, k)\)
Quadratic\(a(x - h)^2 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)Parabola vertex \((h, k)\), axis \(x = h\)
Cubic\(a(x - h)^3 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)Inflection center \((h, k)\), S-curve
Absolute Value\(a|x - h| + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)V-corner vertex \((h, k)\), slopes \(\pm a\)
Radical\(a\sqrt{x - h} + k\)\([h, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)Endpoint \((h, k)\), half-parabola
Rational\(\dfrac{a}{x - h} + k\)\(x \neq h\)\(y \neq k\)Vertical asymptote \(x = h\), horizontal \(y = k\)
Exponential\(a \cdot 2^{x - h} + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((k, \infty)\)Horizontal asymptote \(y = k\), anchor \((h, a+k)\)
Logarithmic\(a\ln(x - h) + k\)\((h, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)Vertical asymptote \(x = h\), anchor \((h+1, k)\)
body.ar:
تُبنى النماذج الجبرية والمتسامية الأساسية من خلال تطبيق التحويل القياسي \(g(x) = a\,f(x - h) + k\) على إحدى الدوال الأم التسع، حيث يتحكم \(|a|\) في التمدد الرأسي (مع انعكاس حول محور السينات إذا كان \(a < 0\))، ويمثل \(h\) الإزاحة الأفقية، و\(k\) الإزاحة الرأسية:

عائلة الدالةالصورة المحوّلة \(g(x)\)المجالالمدى (\(a > 0\))السمة الهندسية المميزة
الثابتة\(f(x) = c\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\(\{c\}\)مستقيم أفقي ميله \(0\)
الخطية\(a(x - h) + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)ميل ثابت \(m = a\) ونقطة ارتكاز \((h, k)\)
التربيعية\(a(x - h)^2 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)قطع مكافئ رأسه \((h, k)\) ومحوره \(x = h\)
التكعيبية\(a(x - h)^3 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)نقطة انعطاف مركزية \((h, k)\)
القيمة المطلقة\(a|x - h| + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)رأس زاوي على شكل V عند \((h, k)\) بميلين \(\pm a\)
الجذرية\(a\sqrt{x - h} + k\)\([h, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)نقطة بداية \((h, k)\) ومجال مقيّد \(x \ge h\)
النسبية (المقلوب)\(\dfrac{a}{x - h} + k\)\(x \neq h\)\(y \neq k\)تقارب رأسي \(x = h\) وتقارب أفقي \(y = k\)
الأسية\(a \cdot 2^{x - h} + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((k, \infty)\)تقارب أفقي \(y = k\) ونقطة ارتكاز \((h, a+k)\)
اللوغاريتمية\(a\ln(x - h) + k\)\((h, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)تقارب رأسي \(x = h\) ونقطة ارتكاز \((h+1, k)\)
